Michael Qian at “滴水不漏拯救隊” Launch

Michael Qian, dressed in a khaki utility vest over a white T-shirt, attended the launch of TVB’s new program “滴水不漏拯救隊” at Tseung Kwan O Television City. The show brings together celebrities and building seepage experts to perform live water leaka
